hero_subhead: Fully furnished, 24/7 access, no commercial lease. Move in Monday morning and be productive by noon, without the overhead of setting up an office from scratch.
teams_floor_intro: Twenty-plus private offices sit on Den 1880's dedicated Teams Floor, a secure, professional environment designed specifically for teams who want the feel of their own space without the cost and commitment of a commercial lease.
included_intro: No hidden costs, no furniture to source, no contractors to call. Every office comes fully ready.
coworking_intro: Your private office on the Teams Floor includes full main-floor coworking access whenever you want to step out of the suite, and so does every one of your team's seats.
performance_club_intro: Your private office on the Teams Floor includes Performance Club gym access for every seat on your plan. 8 hours of work, 8 hours of play, all under one roof.
pairing_intro: A private office gives your team a home base. A Team plan layers in the rest, the gym, wellness amenities, meeting room credits, and the full Den 1880 experience for every person on your team.
amenities_intro: Your team gets access to amenities most companies can't afford to offer, all steps from their desk.
final_cta_intro: Tours run weekday mornings and afternoons. See the available suites, meet the team, ask anything. We'll show you exactly what your team would be walking into.
